note: Small full-hookup RV park for self-contained rigs on the Doe River in Roan Mountain, a couple of miles from Roan Mountain State Park. All sites are back-ins; the river-side row has a rock seating area at the water for tubing and wading. Pay the balance on arrival in cash or by check. --Claude
summary: Operating claimed RoverPass park (bookable), $50/night full hookup 50A back-ins to 40 ft, open May 1-Nov 1, WiFi, self-contained only, cash/check at arrival. Google 4.9/19 plus own website with phone and a live booking engine = presence passes. Passes the gate exactly at $50. Doe River beside the north row: creekside upgrade candidate.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): cheapest RV night $50.00 (Full Hook Up RV Sites, 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12, RoverPass; one rate only, no seasonal variation seen; tax $0 in the cart; RoverPass platform $3.50 and processing $1.75 are the platform's). Exactly at the line; passes. Closed on the December and March dates. PRESENCE: Google 4.9 from 19 reviews (under 25) but own website with phone 423-957-9089 and a claimed RoverPass engine taking bookings -> passes. RV Life 5*/$$ stored.

WATERFRONT CANDIDATE: stored 'not waterfront' -> propose 'creekside'. The Doe River here is ~10-15 m wide (creek class). RoverPass names sites 6 'ON River Side' (36 ft) and 7 'ON River Side' (31 ft) and labels 1b and 8-11 'Creekside Site'; on leaf-off Esri imagery the north pad row (around 36.1710,-82.0823) backs onto the riparian strip with the channel ~10-20 m beyond the pads; the operator's gallery shows a site fire ring with the stream a few metres behind across open grass, and the rules describe 'A rock area ... where you can set up a chair' at the river. An easy walk down with nothing between, sold nightly ($50). Site labels and the 'Waterfront' tag are marketing and not the basis; the imagery plus the site photo are. Caveat for the reviewer: the photo cannot be tied to a site number, and the riparian trees show bare in the imagery, so this is the creekside test (easy walk down), not an open-apron lake test. The stored evidence ('tree line between the pads and the Doe River') is the basis for keeping it down if the reviewer prefers.

LONG-STAY: 'Extended Stay' tag, 'Long-term stays must be approved by management', gallery shows rigs with built decks/porches. Five tests: (1) no wording discourages nightly guests; (2) nightly $50 posted and bookable online; (3) Google 4.9/19 reviews and gallery mix travellers and regulars; (4) nightly share: RoverPass sells 13 sites nightly; imagery shows roughly 20-25 pads, so about half or more are nightly - at or above the 50% line; (5) no lots sold. Keep.
